name: Railway
region: Customer’s selected region — United States, Europe, or Asia Pacific

name: Vercel
purpose: AI Gateway — routes hosted model requests to upstream providers; Vercel Sandbox — isolated microVM execution of agent explore/Python tools over semantic-layer content, knowledge-base documents, and query results

name: Anthropic
purpose: Upstream hosted model inference (default; reached via Vercel AI Gateway)

name: OpenAI
purpose: Upstream hosted model inference (opt-in; reached via Vercel AI Gateway)

name: Slack
purpose: Chat delivery — the Atlas Slack app posts answers and query results into Customer’s Slack workspace and receives questions from it; per-workspace bot tokens are stored encrypted by Atlas
region: Customer’s own Slack workspace — data location determined by Customer’s agreement with Slack

name: Microsoft
purpose: Chat delivery — the Atlas bot for Microsoft Teams posts answers and query results into Customer’s Teams tenant and receives questions from it; per-workspace bot credentials are stored encrypted by Atlas. Listed for chat delivery only: where Customer connects an Outlook mailbox as a knowledge source, Atlas reads from Customer’s own Microsoft tenant under credentials Customer grants and discloses no Personal Data to Microsoft, so that use is a source rather than a sub-processing engagement
region: Customer’s own Microsoft 365 tenant — data location determined by Customer’s agreement with Microsoft

name: Discord
purpose: Chat delivery — the Atlas Discord bot posts answers and query results into Customer’s Discord server and receives questions from it; per-workspace bot tokens are stored encrypted by Atlas
region: Customer’s own Discord server — data location determined by Customer’s agreement with Discord

name: Telegram
purpose: Chat delivery — the Atlas Telegram bot posts answers and query results into Customer’s Telegram chats and receives questions from them; per-workspace bot tokens are stored encrypted by Atlas
region: Global — data location determined by Customer’s agreement with Telegram

name: WhatsApp (Meta Platforms)
purpose: Chat delivery — the Atlas WhatsApp Business integration posts answers and query results into Customer’s WhatsApp conversations and receives questions from them; per-workspace credentials are stored encrypted by Atlas
region: Global — data location determined by Customer’s agreement with Meta

name: Cloudflare
purpose: Bot mitigation (Turnstile on signup / abuse-sensitive endpoints) + CDN/edge proxy; receives end-user IP address

name: Twenty
purpose: Customer-relationship management — stores signup and sales-enquiry contact details (name, email) for sales follow-up
region: Customer’s selected region — co-located with Atlas infrastructure
